crossRefs.note: Woe is me, my mother, that you have borne me, a man of strife, and a man of contention to the whole earth! I have not…
“Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

translations.web: Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
translations.bsb: Cursed be the day I was born! May the day my mother bore me never be blessed.
translations.kjv: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
translations.asv: Cursed be the day wherein I was born: let not the day wherein my mother bare me be blessed.
